Algorithm 1 The PODS Framework for GRPO Input: Models π θ , π θ fixed , input prompt p, reward model R, Number of rollouts n, update size m, down-sampling rule D 1: Independently sample n rollouts o = (o 1 , o 2 , . . . , o n ) using π θ fixed for prompt p 2: Compute rewards r = (r 1 , r 2 , . . . , r n ) using the reward model R 3: Down-sample a set of m rollouts S ← D(o, r; m) 4: Update the policy using the GRPO-PODS objective L PODS (θ, S) Output: An updated model π θ updated
